plan.title: Agentic routing: risk/complexity classification, assignment, multi-review, preflight
plan.goal: One versioned work-class record drives lane assignment, review requirements and local preflight, enforced in trusted CI
success_criteria: Oversize local work is refused before inference with a visible state
Core changes require two valid independent receipts, enforced by trusted CI
Dispatches from CLI and Agent tool yield correlated records with honest model/effort

items.name: Plan frozen
items.goal: Merged plan frozen as MVP scope
items.validation_goal: FREEZE.md and PLAN.md merged; Codex PASS_WITH_FOLLOWUPS recorded

items.name: S1 local preflight + normalized dispatch evidence
items.goal: Refuse oversize local prompts before inference using assembled prompt + overhead + output allowance; normalize dispatch registry fields; refusal dashboard state
items.validation_goal: Oversize local dispatch refused pre-launch in live QA; accepted work fits context; dashboard shows refusals; usage unknown stays unknown

items.name: S2 core classification + multi-review enforcement
items.goal: Precise core rules in risk_tier.py/risk-tier-policy.json; structured multi-review receipts; trusted-base CI consumption; shadow then enforce
items.validation_goal: Canon change classifies core; corrupt/missing policy blocks explicitly; PR weakening classifier cannot weaken its acceptance; duplicate/stale/author-conflicting receipts fail; two valid reviews pass

items.name: S3 assignment defaults + Agent coverage
items.goal: Wrappers write the shared work-class record, record substitutions, enforce explicit eligible model selection; Agent-tool hook with dispatch/completion correlation
items.validation_goal: Real CLI and Agent dispatches produce correlated records; Codex cooldown selects qualified substitute or blocks; Agent enforcement on only after live hook demonstration

items.name: Launch profiles
items.goal: Child launch profiles via real configuration and tool permissions
items.validation_goal: Profile changes actual child tool permissions, not only advertised skills

items.name: Modality probes (transcript + keyframes for media)
items.goal: Capability probes per model/account; media lanes require transcript plus keyframes
items.validation_goal: Probe results dated and re-run on staleness

items.name: Wider enforcement + calibrated content signals
items.goal: Extend enforcement beyond core after corpus testing; calibrated keyword/novelty signals
items.validation_goal: False-positive/negative rates measured on a representative corpus

items.name: Coordinator/tracker integration + shadow lane qualification
items.goal: Surface routing records in coordinator and PM tracker; qualify local lanes from shadow results
items.validation_goal: Qualification derived from measured shadow outcomes; review counters survive lane substitution
